summary: Rebuild and update app UI/navigation: keep Logout in Settings, add Profile at top, and add a Reel button after Videos.

existing_features.title: In the top header (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx), replace the authenticated-state primary button text/action from "Logout" to "Profile" so that when the user is authenticated it navigates to "/profile" instead of logging out. When the user is not authenticated, the button must remain "Login" and must continue to trigger the Internet Identity login flow.

Keep the Logout action available under the Settings (gear) menu in the header (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx) and ensure it still logs the user out (clears identity and clears React Query cache) when clicked.

Add a new primary navigation item labeled "Reel" positioned immediately after "Video" in the bottom navigation (frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx). Create a new route at "/reel" in the router (frontend/src/App.tsx) and implement a placeholder Reel page (new file under frontend/src/pages) with English user-facing text indicating the Reel feed is coming soon, similar in structure to the existing Video placeholder page.

new_feature_requests.summary: Keep Logout option in Settings (do not remove it from Settings).
Replace the top-level Logout with a Profile option at the top of the UI/navigation.
Add a Reel button after the Videos section/button.

projectName: Update navigation: move Logout into Settings, add Profile in header, and add Reels after Video
